title: Pretrained model screening nominates Astragalus-ginseng for ovarian aging
summary: A multi-strategy framework combining single-cell analysis, literature mining and a 712-molecule compound library used the ESM-T5 pretrained protein-molecule model (best of six combinations) to predict compound-target affinity, pointing to the Astragalus-ginseng pair. SPR and molecular dynamics supported binding to CYP19A1, SERPINE1 and MDK targets, and the pair ameliorated granulosa cell senescence and diminished ovarian function in cyclophosphamide-treated rats. It is a preprint at abstract level; the model is one of several strategies, and only cell and rat models were used.
ai_technology: ESM-T5 pretrained protein-molecule representation model for compound-target affinity prediction
organization: Sichuan Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: SPR and molecular dynamics of predictions, a KGN cell senescence model and a cyclophosphamide rat model.
evidence.unknown: Prediction-versus-SPR numbers and any human efficacy. Full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicted compound-target affinity to prioritize herb constituents.
